decisions.decision: The COA will vote on accepting the new Board Member Orientation packet at its next meeting, so the packet is deferred.
decisions.quote: we will vote on accepting the packet at the next coa meeting.

decisions.decision: The Lunenburg Business Association will assist the COA in developing a new logo for the Eagle House Senior Community Center.
decisions.quote: the lunenburg business association will assist the coa with developing a new logo for the eagle house senior community center.

decisions.decision: Catering will be tried for the Volunteer/Legislative Breakfast this year.
decisions.quote: catering the breakfast will be tried this year.

decisions.decision: Selectman Franco will report to the COA on progress toward the Senior Tax Relief goal.
decisions.quote: selectman franco will report to coa on progress toward this goal.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Ms. Doherty reported the FY23 State Formula Grant Funds, including the FY22 surplus, as a balance.
budget_items.quote: the fy23 state formula grant funds including fy22 surplus is $42,306.31.

budget_items.topic: New patio funding from the state
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Representative Cronin secured state funding for the patio construction.
budget_items.quote: representative cronin secured $100,000.00 from the state for construction of this patio.

budget_items.topic: New patio in the Capital Plan
budget_items.what_was_recorded: The same $100,000.00 was included in the Capital Plan for the patio project.
budget_items.quote: $100,000.00 has also been included in the capital plan for this project.

budget_items.topic: Patio check presentation at the breakfast
budget_items.what_was_recorded: A $100,000.00 check for the patio is to be presented by Senator Cronin at the Volunteer/Legislative Breakfast.
budget_items.quote: the $100,000.00 check for the new patio and recreation area will be presented there by senator cronin.
